title: Isra and Mi'raj diagram and prayer chart
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Spring 1: Ta'if, Isra and Mi'raj, and sawm
source: Written for islamic-studies/y5 lesson 5 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Isra and Mi'raj diagram and prayer chart)
intro: Lesson 5: Isra and Mi'raj: the gift of the five prayers. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

passage.title: al-Isra 17:1
paras: Exalted is He who took His Servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs.

model.title: How many prayers were first given, and what reward do the five carry?

parts.text: Musa advised asking to make them fewer
Five prayers carry the reward of fifty

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Five prayers a day, with the reward of fifty

frame.label: Isra: Makkah to Jerusalem. Three facts:
Mi'raj: through the heavens. Three facts:

keywords.def: the night journey from Makkah to Jerusalem
the rising up through the heavens
the one who always believes the truth: Abu Bakr

questions.q: Explain the difference between Isra and Mi'raj.
questions.a: Isra: night journey from Makkah to Jerusalem. Mi'raj: rising through the heavens.

questions.q: How many prayers were first given?
Why was Abu Bakr called as-Siddiq?
questions.a: He believed the Prophet ﷺ immediately.

questions.q: Complete a two-part journey diagram labelled Isra and Mi'raj, with three facts for each.
questions.a: Isra: Makkah, Jerusalem, led prophets in prayer. Mi'raj: seven heavens, met prophets, gift of salah.

questions.q: Extend: what does the reduction from fifty to five teach us about Allah?
questions.a: He is merciful and makes the religion easy.

questions.q: Stretch: how should knowing salah's story change how we pray?
questions.a: We value it as a gift and pray on time with focus.

questions.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ bring back from the Mi'raj?
questions.a: A) The five daily prayers. Salah was made obligatory on that night. Fasting and Hajj came later.

questions.q: Think again: how will you look after the gift of salah?
questions.a: For example: pray on time with focus.
